definitions.explanation: A wearable device worn on the wrist that connects to a smartphone and tracks fitness data, notifications, and time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧スマートウォッチ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
スマートウォッチ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{歩数|ほすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}っている→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: I track my step count with a smartwatch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議中|かいぎちゅう}→会議中：16781_kaigichuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧スマートウォッチ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ちらっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I got a notification on my smartwatch during the meeting, so I glanced at the screen.

notes:
From English 'smartwatch'. Refers to wrist-worn devices like the Apple Watch, Fitbit, or Garmin smartwatches.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スマートウォッチ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to wear a smartwatch

- スマートウォッチ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧: to receive notifications on a smartwatch
